title: How to Ask for Directions in Swedish | SvenskaVardag
text:
Lost on the way to the train? 🚆 Say: Hur kommer jag till stationen?

🎓 Today: ursäkta = excuse me, rakt fram = straight ahead, vänster / höger = left / right.

Now try it with another place in the comments: Hur kommer jag till apoteket?

👉 Follow @svenskavardag for a little Swedish every day. Share this with a friend who is learning Swedish.
